name: PD 470 was established by Ordinance No. 23085, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 9,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 470 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 470.

PD 470.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 470 was established by Ordinance No. 23085, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 9, 1997. Ordinance No. 23085 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 470 is established on property generally located on the northeast corner of Northwest Highway and Douglas Avenue. The size of PD 470 is approximately 2.256 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 470A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only use permitted on the Property is surface parking for the church use located at the northwest corner of Northwest Highway and Douglas Avenue on Lot 1 of City Block 9A/5599. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Except as provided below, the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Section 51A- 4.122(b), “CR Community Retail District,” apply to this PD.

(b) Minimum front, side, and rear yards are as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

No off-street parking is required. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Divisions 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. Parking located on the Property may not be used to satisfy the required off-street parking requirements for a use located on another building site. All off-street parking must be provided at or below ground level. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.110. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.111. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping for the Property must be provided as shown on the development plan. Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. Upon approval of the department of public works and transportation and prior to use of the site, “No Parking” signs must be installed as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.113. FENCING.

Fencing must be provided and maintained as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.114. LIGHTING.

Maximum height for any lighting fixture, either wall mounted or free-standing, is four feet. All fixtures must comply with Section 51A-4.301(2)(A), (B), and (C). The parking lot must be lighted during

nighttime hours of operation. For purposes of this provision, nighttime means one-half hour before sunset to one-half hour after sunrise. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Security
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.115. SECURITY.

The gates shown on the development plan must be closed and locked when the Property is not in use. Security must patrol the Property during its use. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.116. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.117. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.118. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-470.119. ZONING MAP.

PD 470 is located on Zoning Map No. F-7. (Ord. Nos. 23085; 26042)
